description: A signed in customer's teas.co.uk account; the assistant asks the person to link their account the first time. section "profile", "orders" (recent), "order" (status and courier tracking, order_number), "invoice" (order_number), "rewards" (reward points), "subscriptions" (repeat deliveries) or "returns" (return requests). Three changes run only when the person clearly asks and has confirmed the details: action "reorder" (order_number, optional only_ids) puts an earlier order back in the basket; "pause_subscription", "resume_subscription" or "cancel_subscription" (subscription_id; cancel is final); "start_return" (order_number, reason, items, details) sends a return request for review. Reward points are spent only by the person on teas.co.uk.

action.description: A change, only when the person asked for it.

details.description: Return: what happened, in the person's words.

only_ids.description: Reorder: only these product ids from the order.

reason.description: Return: damaged, faulty, wrong_item, missing_item, change_of_mind (unused and unopened) or other.

name: my_account

outputSchema.description: The page or result; its shape depends on page, section or action.
